from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
import json
import pytest

from mcp.server.mcpserver.limits import LimitEnforcer, LimitPolicy, Quota
from mcp.server.mcpserver.server import MCPServer


@pytest.fixture
def anyio_backend():
    return "asyncio"


def _make_client(server):
    for mod_name in ("mcp.client", "mcp.server.mcpserver", "mcp"):
        try:
            mod = __import__(mod_name, fromlist=["Client"])
            if hasattr(mod, "Client"):
                return getattr(mod, "Client")(server)
        except ImportError:
            pass
    raise RuntimeError("Client not found in mcp.client, mcp.server.mcpserver, or mcp")


@asynccontextmanager
async def _client_session(server):
    client = _make_client(server)
    if hasattr(client, "__aenter__"):
        async with client as c:
            yield c
    else:
        yield client


def _extract_text(res) -> str:
    if isinstance(res, list):
        item = res[0]
    elif hasattr(res, "contents"):
        item = res.contents[0]
    else:
        item = res
    return getattr(item, "text", getattr(item, "content", str(item)))


def test_snapshot_empty_tools():
    enforcer = LimitEnforcer()
    assert enforcer.snapshot({}, scope_key=None) == {"tools": {}}


def test_snapshot_preserves_tool_order():
    enforcer = LimitEnforcer()
    p1 = LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=5))
    p2 = LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=10))
    snap = enforcer.snapshot({"second": p1, "first": p2}, scope_key=None)
    assert list(snap["tools"].keys()) == ["second", "first"]


def test_snapshot_json_dumps_serializable():
    enforcer = LimitEnforcer()
    p = LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3))
    snap = enforcer.snapshot({"tool": p}, scope_key=None)
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(snap)) == snap


def test_snapshot_policy_dict():

def test_snapshot_session_scope_isolation():
    enforcer = LimitEnforcer()
    p = LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3), scope="session")
    enforcer.decide("search", p, scope_key="session-1")
    snap = enforcer.snapshot({"search": p}, scope_key="session-2")
    assert snap["tools"]["search"]["remaining"] == 3

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_read_resource_reflects_modified_limits():

    @server.tool(limits=LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=2)))
    def search(q: str) -> str:

    server.enable_limits_resource()

    assert json.loads(list(contents)[0].content)["tools"]["search"]["remaining"] == 10

@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_client_read_resource_over_protocol():
    server = MCPServer()
    @server.tool(limits=LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3), scope="session"))
    def search(q: str) -> str:
        return q
    server.enable_limits_resource()
    async with _client_session(server) as client:
        res = await client.read_resource("limits://status")
        assert json.loads(_extract_text(res))["tools"]["search"]["remaining"] == 3


@pytest.mark.anyio
async def test_client_tool_call_decrements_session_remaining():
    server = MCPServer()
    @server.tool(limits=LimitPolicy(quota=Quota(max_calls=3), scope="session"))
    def search(q: str) -> str:
        return q
    server.enable_limits_resource()
    async with _client_session(server) as client:
        await client.call_tool("search", {"q": "hello"})
        res = await client.read_resource("limits://status")
        assert json.loads(_extract_text(res))["tools"]["search"]["remaining"] == 2
